Title: uTPro SEO Audit
Description: Full SEO and site audit for Umbraco (16, 17, 18), formerly uTPro URL Viewer. Crawls every Content & Media URL (plus sitemap.xml) and checks for broken links, images and resources, then audits each page: SEO (title, meta description, canonical, H1-H3, noindex/nofollow, lang), Open Graph & Twitter cards, technical SEO (HTTPS, gzip, browser caching, schema.org, viewport), content quality (word count, readability, thin & duplicate content), a static accessibility subset (aria, skip links, heading structure, unlabelled inputs) and estimated carbon emissions with an A-F rating. Get a per-run health score, issues grouped by severity/priority, orphaned-page detection, incremental scans, CSV export and a per-page detail view - all inside the backoffice. Still includes the original fetch-as-Googlebot/Bingbot URL Viewer tool (full redirect chain, response headers, HTML source, cloaking and spam/hack detection, VirusTotal link). Runs as a recurring background job (auto-discovered by uTPro Job Monitor). Server-side and SSRF-safe (blocks private/local addresses).
